study_design: Age-matched case-control study of prostate cancer patients and healthy controls.
reason: The abstract reports associations with prostate cancer overall. Its concluding reference to risk for aggressive prostate cancer and interaction with PSA levels does not establish a separately analyzed aggressive incident endpoint or provide an aggressive case definition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The odds ratio (OR) and 95% confidence interval (CI) for PC was 0.07 (0.04-0.13) among participants with a plasma selenium level >28.06 μg/dL vs. ≤19.13 μg/dL.
estimate_classifications.reason: This selenium estimate is explicitly for prostate cancer overall, not for an aggressive prostate cancer subgroup.
